title: Booking a Holiday
description: Four recordings about planning and booking a holiday: a travel agent, a radio programme, a hotel call and a talk.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · At the travel agent
parts.intro: You will hear Nam talking to a travel agent called Clara.

script.speaker: Clara
script.text: Good morning. Can I help you?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Yes, please. I'd like to book a holiday for my family. There are four of us.

script.speaker: Clara
script.text: Of course. Where would you like to go?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Well, we wanted to go to Spain, but my wife prefers Greece. She loves swimming in the sea.

script.speaker: Clara
script.text: Greece is lovely in July. The hotels are quite cheap then, and the weather is very hot.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: That sounds good. How much is a week for four people?

script.speaker: Clara
script.text: It's nine hundred pounds with flights. Breakfast is included, but dinner is not.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Hmm, that's a bit more than I wanted to pay. Is there anything cheaper?

script.speaker: Clara
script.text: Well, you could fly on a Tuesday instead of a Saturday. That saves one hundred pounds.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Great, let's do that. We'll leave on the fifth of July.

parts.title: Part 2 · A radio programme
parts.intro: You will hear a radio presenter talking about holiday offers.

script.speaker: Helen
script.text: Good afternoon, listeners. This week on Holiday Hour, we are talking about cheap summer deals.

script.speaker: Helen
script.text: Our first offer is a trip to the island of Malta. It costs only four hundred pounds for five days, and children under ten travel free.

script.speaker: Helen
script.text: Our second offer is a mountain holiday in Austria. It's not as cheap, at six hundred pounds, but the price includes ski lessons. Oh, sorry, I mean walking tours, because there is no snow in summer!

script.speaker: Helen
script.text: If you want to book, please call before the end of the month. The number is on our website.

script.speaker: Helen
script.text: And remember, anyone who books online this week gets a free map and a bottle of water.

parts.title: Part 3 · A phone call to a hotel
parts.intro: You will hear Minh phoning a hotel.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Sunny Bay Hotel, Linh speaking. How can I help you?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Hello. This is Minh Tran. I have a room booked for next weekend, but I need to change it.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Of course. Can you tell me the date of your booking?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Yes, I'm arriving on Friday the twelfth. But my train is cancelled, so I can only come on Saturday.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: No problem. Saturday the thirteenth. Is that for two nights still?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Actually, just one night, then. I must be back at work on Monday morning.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: I see. And you wanted a room with a sea view, is that right?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Yes, please, if possible. And can I have a quiet room? Last time, there was a lot of noise from the restaurant.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Certainly. I'll put you on the second floor, at the back. Breakfast is from seven to ten.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Perfect. Thanks very much for your help.

parts.title: Part 4 · Holiday tips
parts.intro: You will hear a man giving a talk about holiday tips.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: Hello, everyone. Today I'm going to give you some tips for a happy holiday.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: First, make a list before you pack. Many people forget small things like a charger or sun cream.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: Second, put your passport and tickets in your hand bag, not in your suitcase. If the airline loses your suitcase, you'll still have your documents.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: Third, check the weather. Don't take only summer clothes, because it can rain even in hot countries.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: Finally, learn a few words of the local language. When I went to Italy last year, I learned how to say hello and thank you.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: People were so friendly, and I got a free coffee in one café! So, have a wonderful trip.
